name: Carrot le Angola
original_name: キャロット・ル・アンゴラ
source:
A princess and daughter of the king Angora le Celery Lop Dutch White Wooly Satin Hare Giant Rabi-Isle.

Her older sibling suggested getting an education in Japan as she is half Japanese. She lives in a tent in the park and eats whatever she can find that's edible along with her servant [url=https://vndb.org/c22138]Taiga[/url] because things are too expensive in Japan and nobody is willing to hire a golden haired foreigner.

Term of endearment for her [url=/c95232]husband[/url] danna-sama (beloved husband/master).
translation:
安哥拉国王芹菜·安哥拉·洛普·荷兰白绒缎毛巨型兔岛的女儿。

她的兄长建议她到日本接受教育，因为她有一半日本血统。她和仆人[url=https://vndb.org/c22138]泰加[/url]住在公园的帐篷里，靠找到的可食用东西充饥；毕竟日本物价太高，也没人愿意雇用金发外国人。

她对[url=/c95232]丈夫[/url]的爱称是“老爷”。
